en-US: Build 203 internal device test. Build 202 (beta.59) failed in the accepted-SDK cloud build (run 35474286467, exit 65) and was never uploaded; its tag stays frozen at the failed source. New since build 202: (1) the Swift 6 OutlineGroup child-keypath compile failure in the source-control change tree is repaired. (2) The release rebuild now captures the full xcodebuild log and an xcresult, prints an error/warning summary and uploads a failure-only diagnostics artifact, while a successful rebuild still continues into packaging. Carried over from build 202: post-tool replay/checkpoint memory is bounded; the IDE discovers nested Git repositories and shows a collapsible directory change tree; Office open/save/retry is bounded (CodeBlitz error-95 toast still needs your device verification); image files open an editor from workspace previews; the GitHub app release will be a normal Latest release, not a prerelease. Validation is intentionally limited to focused checks plus one cloud App build; full UI/device acceptance is yours. No public beta or App Store production release is included.
zh-Hans: Build 203 内部真机测试。Build 202（beta.59）在 accepted-SDK 云端构建中失败（run 35474286467，exit 65），从未上传；其标签冻结在失败来源不动。相较 Build 202 的新内容：① 修复源码控制变更树的 Swift 6 OutlineGroup 子节点 keypath 编译失败。② 发布重建现在保存完整 xcodebuild 日志与 xcresult，失败时打印 error/warning 摘要并上传仅失败时的诊断产物，而重建成功仍会进入打包。自 Build 202 继承：工具后重放／检查点内存有界；IDE 沿祖先目录发现嵌套 Git 仓库并以可折叠目录树展示变更；Office 打开／保存／重试有界（CodeBlitz error-95 toast 仍需你真机验证）；图片可从工作区预览直接进入编辑器；本版 GitHub App 发布将为正常 Latest，不是预发布。本轮验证刻意限定为聚焦检查加一次云端 App 构建；完整 UI／真机验收由你完成。本轮不含公开 Beta 或 App Store 生产发布。
